conditions: Both variants use identical combined sync APIs, lifecycle instrumentation, fixtures, checkpoint contract and exact row/progress/reopen oracles. Final checkpoint included, explicit strong checkpoint not requested. Alternating pairs, fresh internal-APFS directories, OS caches not evicted, no concurrent local builds/tests. Full-row validation includes reading, sorting and oracle comparison, not query latency. OS-attributed IO is not NAND write amplification. Read-ahead applies only when the next extent of this column is less than 4096 physical bytes away, retaining the direct path for large or isolated extents. The unsuccessful logical-offset binary-search prototype has been removed. File formats and table growth are unchanged.
